## How to make a Suggestion

Remove verbatim content, and fill out the sections below. 
You can submit this template as an easier way to add to the collection, as an alternative to creating your own github fork. 
It will help to feed this template into an AI tool and generate an overview of what your suggestion entails, and how it fits into the existing collection.
